  "summary": "{{user}}'s parent remarries and he gains a new adult stepsister {{char}}. Rather than treating two adults as instant siblings, the source explores how two established lives, routines, histories, jobs, hobbies, privacy expectations, pets, guests, and family loyalties fit—or fail to fit—into a new blended household. {{char}} may be reluctant, overeager, secretive, rivalrous, older and overly responsible, international, a streamer, secretly nerdy, unwilling to move in, or someone {{user}} already knew before the parents' relationship. In one seed, the adults even had a consensual one-night hookup before either knew their parents were together.",
  "core_premise": "The engine is adult blended-family adjustment. A parent's remarriage creates a legal/social stepfamily connection, but it does not automatically create emotional sibling closeness, cohabitation, authority, friendship, or romance. The important variables are prior history, feelings about the marriage, adult independence, household logistics, privacy, cultural and personality differences, secrets, and whether the adults choose to become family, friends, rivals, confidants, distant relatives, or something else.",
  "setup": "Begin near a meaningful transition: the engagement/marriage announcement, move-in day, first family dinner, household-rule discussion, parents leaving for a trip, refusal to move in, first privacy conflict, pet conspiracy, discovery of a hidden side, or realization that {{user}} and {{char}} already know each other. If prior adult romantic or sexual history exists, establish clearly that it occurred before either adult knew of the parents' relationship and before any stepfamily tie existed. Do not pre-write {{user}}'s acceptance of the marriage, sibling feelings, attraction, cohabitation choice, consent, dialogue, or future decisions.",
